October didn't end when the calendar turned. Peter Steele trapped it in amber — in that impossibly deep baritone that sounded like a cello made of coffin wood. October Rust was never an album. It was a spell cast over Brooklyn that spread like ivy across the gothic underground.

This hoodie is woven from that same eternal autumn. Dark fabric carrying the weight of a voice too large for one body, too beautiful for one lifetime. Vampiric elegance for those who mourn in style and find romance in the decay.

etsy_description:
Wrap yourself in the eternal autumn of Type O Negative with this gothic doom metal hoodie that channels Peter Steele's towering vampiric presence and the haunting beauty of October Rust. This pullover captures the essence of Brooklyn goth — where doom metal meets dark romance in a voice deeper than any grave.

The dark art design reflects Type O Negative's unique aesthetic — vampiric elegance filtered through working-class New York attitude, creating something genuinely original in the gothic metal landscape. Premium heavyweight fabric provides the warmth and weight that matches the band's monolithic sound.

This gothic pullover is crafted for fans who understand that Type O Negative existed in a category of their own. Peter Steele's impossibly deep baritone, the lush October Rust arrangements, the self-deprecating humor hiding genuine darkness — this hoodie embodies all of it.

For the select few who find beauty in decay and romance in the macabre. An essential heavy metal gift for doom metal devotees, gothic fashion enthusiasts, and anyone who has ever felt that autumn should last forever.

Unisex fit. Machine washable. Dark as an October midnight in Green-Wood Cemetery.
